name: Material Science
boundaries: Material Science: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical plasma-facing material for fusion reactors
original_dispositions.reason: Heat-flux tolerance near 10 MW m−2 is an ITER design load already addressed with tungsten. The unsolved materials revolution is the combined neutron lifetime, which MAS-05 already states. Splitting off a second fusion-materials ID would duplicate that concept.

original_dispositions.original_title: Dendrite-free solid-state lithium-metal electrolyte at 500–1000 Wh/kg, 10-minute charging, and 10,000 cycles
original_dispositions.reason: The strongest verified cell near that energy is a gel electrolyte at 604.2 Wh kg−1 for a little over 100 cycles, not the combined historical specification. The revolutionary storage ceiling is already MAS-06. Dendrite control remains an unsolved engineering barrier, not by itself a new principle at the calibration scale.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scalable macroscopic assembly of defect-free graphene or carbon nanotubes
original_dispositions.reason: The 2026 fibers approach the low end of individual-tube strength and are not bulk, tough, affordable structure.

Broadband invisibility remains a challenge; truly broadband passive cloaking remains constrained by passivity and causality. Narrowband scattering reduction would be a device demonstration, and the claimed applications do not match the stated revolutionary-impact scale.

original_dispositions.original_title: Thermoelectric material with ZT above 5–10 at room temperature
original_dispositions.reason: The target would improve a known heat-to-electricity converter that remains inside the Carnot limit. The historical claim of adding 10–30% to engines and power plants was not supported by a source the notes could verify.
The target is fermentation-scale production of a property set biology already achieves. MAS-02 holds the higher bar of tough bulk matter near the ideal lattice limit.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect, durable super-self-cleaning and self-healing structural coating
original_dispositions.reason: Superhydrophobic surfaces and limited self-healing polymers already exist. Recovery of structural load after a macroscopic crack is the related revolutionary claim, and it is MAS-09.

original_dispositions.original_title: Efficient, scalable artificial photosynthesis catalyst above 20–30% solar-to-fuel efficiency
original_dispositions.reason: That efficiency is already demonstrated for hydrogen by a coupled photovoltaic-electrolysis module, not by a missing catalyst principle. Cost, durability, earth-abundant absorbers, and liquid fuels from CO2 remain important scale-up problems.

original_dispositions.original_title: Room-temperature topological quantum material for spintronics or computing
original_dispositions.reason: The kept scope is verified non-Abelian operation at liquid-nitrogen temperature or above. Ambient spin currents alone were not given a separate ID.

reconciliation_change_log.change: MAS-01 through MAS-10 are retained with the same IDs and the same underlying concepts. No entry was deleted, replaced, or merged away.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The ten first-pass concepts are unchanged in identity.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Current state now includes the October 2025 LaSc2H24 preprint and the August 2026 preprint reporting seven failed reproduction attempts. The unsupported “10% of electricity” impact figure from the historical list was not added.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Both preprints concern high-pressure results and do not close the ambient-pressure gap; the impact figure was not tied to a verified source.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Industrial graphene or carbon-nanotube assembly, including retention of tube-like conductivity, is explicitly identified as the same ceiling as near-ideal strength with toughness. Wang et al. 2026 conductivity is cited.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: This flags the historical macroscopic-nanocarbon item without giving it a second ID.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Steady heat flux, erosion, and tritium are included as part of the same service environment. A 2025 divertor-physics chapter is cited for the ITER-scale 10 MW m−2 heat-load design point.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Tungsten hardware already targets that heat load; the unsolved revolutionary remainder remains plant-lifetime displacement damage plus helium.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The current state uses Peng et al. 2025 and its 360 Wh kg−1 lithium-ion comparison. Hydrogen’s 39.4 kWh/kg higher heating value is the fuel benchmark.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The result is a gel-solid-state 604.2 Wh kg−1 pouch cell for just over 100 cycles, not an all-ceramic, dendrite-free, 10,000-cycle battery.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Lithium-mediated ammonia is recorded as a genuine ambient-condition route, with reported selectivities near 100% at elevated pressure and energy efficiencies around 14%, against Haber–Bosch energy efficiencies around 56–62% in a 2025 review.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The concept remains unachieved at industrial ambient intensity.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Ambient spin currents and axion-insulator devices are identified as narrower than the kept non-Abelian scope and are not split out.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: They do not warrant another concept within the stated scope.

reconciliation_change_log.change: No MAS-11 or later ID was assigned.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical items not already inside MAS-01–10 did not meet the stated revolutionary-impact standard once their cited efficiency, ZT, fiber, coating, and cloak claims were checked against primary or review literature.
